title: When syncing to xDrip, only BG and basals are uploaded.
symptom: When syncing to xDrip, treatments (Carbs & bolus) are missing. Only BG and basals are uploaded.
cause: The issue is caused by xDrip not implementing the necessary functionality to receive all data from AAPS.
fix: Update to xDrip latest nightly version (2023.06.17) and enable 'Enable Broadcast to xDrip+' and 'Send status line to xDrip+' in AAPS.
settings_changed: Send status line to xDrip+ → enabled
evidence_quote: Issue fixed with xDrip latest nightly version: https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/releases/tag/2023.06.17
